data.name: Crownless: Reignfall
data.detailed_description:
Crownless: Reignfall is a living-world survival RPG for one player, set in a generated tile world where six factions wage a war that does not wait for you. Ride out, raid the land, extract with what you carry — and live with what the world remembers.

RIDE INTO A WORLD THAT MOVES WITHOUT YOU

There is no throne and no prophecy. Humans, orcs, elves, dwarves, goblins and the undead grind a daily war across the map. Borders shift, prices move, patrols redeploy, and camps rise on tiles that were empty yesterday. Chopped trees stay stumps, looted camps stay looted, and the raider who beat you learns your name. You are not the chosen one here. You are a variable.

RAID, EXTRACT — OR FEED THE HEX

Every run is a bet. Gear up at your hideout, saddle your horse and ride into a tile where something is already happening: a caravan under attack, a war camp digging in, two sides fighting over ground you want. Hunt, forage, fish, chop, mine, dig and loot while the clock keeps running. Reach the exit alive and everything is yours. Fall, and you wake with nothing but your skin.

SURVIVE, CRAFT AND MAKE A HOME

Hunger, thirst, fatigue and cold are not bars to ignore. Wounds are not hit points: broken limbs limp and lost limbs stay lost. Craft in the field from whatever the last tile gave you, repair your gear, cook what you hunted, grow crops, and raise a home that persists — bedroll, fire, walls, chest, forge. A tile becomes home because you made it one.

A living world that ticks daily — six factions with their own territory, power and grudges; the map changes whether you are there or not.

KEY FEATURES

  • Persistent traces — tiles remember what you chopped, dug, burned, looted and killed.

  • Raid-and-extract loop — every run risks what you carry; the only safe place is home.

  • Weighty stamina combat — melee and ranged, blocking, parry, riposte and shield bash. Heavy steel settles slow and hits like it.

  • Survival with teeth — hunger, thirst, fatigue and warmth, and wounds that limp, bleed and take limbs. Prosthetics exist.

  • Field crafting and a home you build — bandage, torch, tools and camp in the field; bedroll, fire, walls, chest and forge on the tile you claim. Grow crops and cook.

  • Horses, wildlife and predators — ride, hunt, skin, or get out of the way.

  • A world market — trade, prices and supply move with the war and with what you sell.

  • Random events — ambushes, war camps, caravans, refugees and encounters that were not staged for you.

  • The Nemesis — the raider who keeps putting you down remembers you, and comes back.

  • Character creation — play as human, elf, dwarf or orc, and dress the part.

  • Bosses at the tiles— Fight massive bosses to unlock secrets.


    MADE BY ONE PERSON, IN DEVELOPMENT

    Crownless is built by a single developer, in the open, and it is not finished. Content, systems and balance will change before and during Early Access. Co-op is planned and not yet playable. Ships and taming are on the backlog, not on the box.

data.short_description: Crownless: Reignfall is an open-world fantasy survival FULL LOOT RPG where you explore procedurally generated lands, fight for survival, encounter rival factions, and shape your own story in a living world where every kingdom has fallen.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: In-scope
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required for online multiplayer. Single-player gameplay is supported offline.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 or AMD RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 80 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Meta and others
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Internet connection required for online multiplayer.

content_descriptors.notes: Crownless: Reignfall is a stylized fantasy survival RPG featuring frequent combat, blood effects, injuries, corpses, and occasional dismemberment/gore. Players can fight humanoid enemies and creatures, loot corpses, recover graves, and encounter dark themes involving death and banditry. The game contains no sexual content.
